name: Parametric Boltless Hook for keyhole shelving units

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a utility hook designed to mount onto boltless shelving units using keyhole slots. It features two circular mounting lugs at the base, spaced apart to align with standard shelf keyholes, with a vertical cylindrical post rising from each. A horizontal support bar spans between the posts, from which a large, angular wedge-shaped hook extends outward and curves upward to hold items.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable hook designed to slot into the keyholes of boltless shelving units. The model should feature two mounting posts with adjustable keyhole diameters (large and small) and spacing, connected by a support bar, and a hook extending from the bar defined by adjustable projection length ('poke') and tip height ('hook').
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a 'wedge' module that creates an angled block by subtracting a rotated cube from a standard cube. The main assembly translates and rotates these wedge modules along with rectangular cubes to form the hook and support bar. Two cylindrical mounting posts are created at the base using cylinder primitives, which are strengthened at the joints using an intersection of a cube and a cylinder ('betterjoints' module) for robust attachment.
